phrases.es: Fui al cine con unos amigos
phrases.en: I went to the movies with some friends
Where did you all go this weekend?
We had a very long meeting
This morning I got up early
Have you ever been to Peru?

phrases.es: Salimos a caminar después de cenar
phrases.en: We went out for a walk after dinner
I saw a really good movie last night
How did the interview go for you?

phrases.es: Pasamos todo el día en la playa
phrases.en: We spent the whole day at the beach

sentences.es: Anoche salimos a cenar y llegamos bastante tarde a casa.
sentences.en: Last night we went out for dinner and got home pretty late.

sentences.es: ¿Podría contarme cómo le fue en su último viaje, señor Duarte?
sentences.en: Could you tell me how your last trip went, Mr. Duarte?

sentences.es: Ayer tuve una cita con el médico y me hicieron varios exámenes.
sentences.en: Yesterday I had a doctor's appointment and they ran several tests.

sentences.es: Oye, ¿qué hiciste el fin de semana? Te perdiste la fiesta.
sentences.en: Hey, what did you do this weekend? You missed the party.

sentences.es: Estimada señora, quisiera saber si ya recibió el paquete que enviamos la semana pasada.
sentences.en: Dear madam, I'd like to know if you've received the package we sent last week.

sentences.es: Fuimos a la playa, nadamos un rato y comimos mariscos frescos.
sentences.en: We went to the beach, swam for a while, and ate fresh seafood.

sentences.es: ¿Ha viajado usted alguna vez a Sudamérica, o sería la primera vez?
sentences.en: Have you ever traveled to South America, or would it be your first time?

sentences.es: No he tenido tiempo de llamarte, perdona, ha sido una semana horrible.
sentences.en: I haven't had time to call you, sorry, it's been a horrible week.

sentences.es: El proyecto se terminó ayer por la tarde, justo antes de la reunión.
sentences.en: The project got finished yesterday afternoon, right before the meeting.

sentences.es: Disculpe la tardanza, tuve un problema con el auto esta mañana.
sentences.en: Sorry for the delay, I had a car problem this morning.

sentences.es: Hicimos tantas cosas ayer que hoy no quiero ni moverme.
sentences.en: We did so many things yesterday that today I don't even want to move.

sentences.es: ¿Me podría confirmar a qué hora llegó el paquete, por favor?
sentences.en: Could you confirm for me what time the package arrived, please?

sentences.es: Nunca había comido comida tailandesa hasta que fuimos a ese restaurante.
sentences.en: I had never eaten Thai food until we went to that restaurant.

sentences.es: Che, ¿ya viste la serie que te recomendé? La terminé anoche.
sentences.en: Hey, have you watched the show I recommended? I finished it last night.

sentences.es: Le agradezco mucho su paciencia; sé que hemos tardado más de lo esperado.
sentences.en: I really appreciate your patience; I know we've taken longer than expected.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Oye, o sea, ¿qué tal tu fin de semana? Al final ¿fuiste al cumpleaños?
dialogue.en: Hey, I mean, how was your weekend? Did you end up going to the birthday party?

dialogue.speaker: tomás
dialogue.es: Sí, pues fui, y estuvo buenísimo, bailamos hasta tarde.
dialogue.en: Yeah, well, I went, and it was great — we danced until late.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Qué envidia, o sea, yo me quedé en casa viendo series.
dialogue.en: So jealous, I mean, I just stayed home watching shows.

dialogue.speaker: tomás
dialogue.es: Bueno, tampoco es que te perdiste tanto, ¿eh? Al final se cortó la luz.
dialogue.en: Well, it's not like you missed that much, huh — the power actually went out in the end.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.en: Haha, seriously? So what did you all do?

dialogue.speaker: tomás
dialogue.es: Pues nada, seguimos con velas, o sea, terminó siendo aún más divertido.
dialogue.en: Well, nothing much, we kept going with candles — I mean, it ended up being even more fun.
